opening.argument: The video promotes higher returns through a referral link tied to lending money on BitConnect, as the description expressly says, “Get an higher return by using my referral link below when you lend money on BitConnect.” The speaker reinforces that solicitation with claims of “about 1 to 1.6% interest daily” and reports, “I have a about twelve thousand dollars in there and I'm earning about roughly about 150 to 200 dollars a day.” Those stated returns are not independently verified, yet they are presented alongside the referral and lending instructions. The separate Coinbase reward and card-verification demonstrations supply referral and tutorial context, but they do not independently establish deception.
